summary: The 6-K filing is a routine report of voting results from CBL International Ltd's 2026 annual general meeting. Shareholders re-elected three directors and ratified the appointment of MRI Moores Rowland LLP as independent auditor for FY2025. The filing does not relate to any special-situation event. As a standard corporate governance disclosure required for foreign private issuers, it maps to a Form 8-K Item 5.07 equivalent. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special situation is described. The only action is the ordinary annual re-election of directors and ratification of auditors.
